title: IndexedSet indexing after removals
issue_text:
IndexedSet slices go wrong once something has been removed

`IndexedSet` is meant to support list-style slicing, but after I take an element out of the set, slices come back with the wrong items. Nothing raises; I just get bad data back.

```python
from boltons.setutils import IndexedSet

s = IndexedSet('abcdefghij')
s.remove('c')    # a b d e f g h i j

list(s[2:5])     # got ['e', 'f', 'g'], expected ['d', 'e', 'f']
list(s[-2:])     # got ['j'], expected ['i', 'j']
```

Rebuilding the set from its remaining items makes the slices correct again. I expected removals not to matter: a slice should match the same slice of a freshly built set with the same items, and forward slices should line up with `list(s)`.

Indexing and `pop` have a related problem: out-of-range negative positions should raise `IndexError` like a list, but `s[-10]` returns `'j'` and `s.pop(-15)` removes `'e'`.
